MBA Monday Leisure Ride

South Bend, IN · Road · Social

No-dropBeginner friendly

MBA Monday Leisure Ride is a road and social group ride in South Bend, IN. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Pinhook Park. About 10–17 miles, 10–13 mph, group stays together. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the MBA Monday Leisure Ride group ride

A hosted leisure ride from Pinhook Park. Ten to seventeen miles at 10–13 mph, and the group always stays together. Distance grows through the season.
